y5f1bf004b48.add: - **Muscles:** skeletal (striated, voluntary – **biceps**); smooth (involuntary – ureters, iris, bronchi, gut); cardiac (heart). Strongest muscle by force = **masseter (jaw)**.

ye37a3040705.add: - **Antibodies** are made by **lymphocytes** (B cells / plasma cells in lymph nodes and spleen); the thymus matures T lymphocytes.

yf3e63c0c5b8.add: - **Acquired immunity:** pathogen-specific, has memory; **primary response low intensity**, secondary high; active vs passive; humoral (B cells) + cell-mediated (T cells). **Innate:** PMN leucocytes, NK cells, monocytes.

y22c7c31690b.add: - **Eye:** light enters through the **cornea** (thin transparent membrane, most of the focusing) → pupil → lens → **retina** (light turned into nerve impulses; image **real, inverted, diminished**).

y9e56f880885.add: - **Glycogen** = storage carbohydrate of liver and muscles; insulin (a **hormone**, beta cells) controls **carbohydrate** metabolism.

y5f26a00eb33.add: - **Body temperature** is regulated by the **hypothalamus** (the body's thermostat).

yd12a85c1171.add: - **Wrong pair to spot:** Cowper's gland – intestine (it is a male reproductive gland).

yfe981b7934b.add: - **Iris vs pupil:** the **iris** (coloured muscular diaphragm) changes the pupil's size and so **controls the light entering**; the **pupil** is the opening (NCERT: 'the pupil regulates and controls the amount of light').

ybdd8440a762.add: - **Kidney flow:** blood in by the **renal artery**, cleaned blood out by the **renal vein**; filtrate from Bowman's capsule passes the tubules where **glucose** and much water are **reabsorbed**; renal blood flow ~**1,200 mL/min**; kidney stones are mostly **calcium oxalate**.

y8c0bfc9a28b.add: - Human body temperature stays ~**37 °C** in all seasons (warm-blooded) – it neither falls in winter nor rises in summer.

y6b7d81d769e.add: - **Growth hormone** (pituitary): excess in childhood → **gigantism**, in adults → acromegaly; deficiency → dwarfism.

y3c9d3fe7d67.add: - **Skeleton:** adult **206 bones**; skull **22** (28 with the 6 ear ossicles, 29 with hyoid); smallest bone **stapes** (middle ear); long bones are **hollow** (marrow cavity); bones joined by **ligaments**; humerus, carpals, talus (**astragalus**), atlas are all human bones.

y6e96e084d21.add: - **Bile** has **no digestive enzymes**; it only **emulsifies fats** – so the liver aids fat digestion without fat-digesting enzymes.

y60f9f52787d.add: - **Fertilisation** in the **fallopian tube (oviduct)** – ampullary region; the embryo implants in the uterus; the embryo's heart forms and begins beating at about the **4th week** (~day 22).
